prompt:
I'm going to travel from May 25 to June 29.
First, I'm going to Halle (Saale), Germany.

During my travel I want to visit Italy (Florence, Rom, Pisa, Capri, Milan), Switzerland (Lugano), Netherlands (Amesterdam, Maastricht), Spain (Madrid, Barcelona), France (Paris, Lyon), Germany (Berlin, Dresden) and Prague.

From May 25-May 29 I want to stay in Halle (Saale), Dresden, Leipzig and Berlin.

I want to visit Prague for only two days, only from June 14-June 16.

After visiting Milan, I want to go Lugano straight and come back to Milan.

I also don't want to visit Venice.

I want to have three days in Paris.

I want to go to the Netherlands from either Paris or Berlin.

On June 27 I want to go back to Halle.

Help me to plan my travel.
answer:
This itinerary fits your fixed dates, gives Paris three full sightseeing days, and includes a direct Milan–Lugano–Milan day trip. It moves quickly, so I’d use trains between nearby cities and flights for the longest journeys.

Dates below are **check-in to check-out**; for example, June 14–16 means two nights in Prague.

| Dates | Overnight base | Plan |
|---|---|---|
| **May 25–27** | **Halle (Saale)** — 2 nights | Arrive May 25. Visit **Leipzig on May 26** and return to Halle. |
| **May 27–28** | **Dresden** — 1 night | Take a morning train to Dresden. Explore the old town, Frauenkirche and the Elbe waterfront. |
| **May 28–30** | **Berlin** — 2 nights | Travel to Berlin May 28. Use May 29 for a full sightseeing day. |
| **May 30–June 1** | **Amsterdam** — 2 nights | Take the train directly from Berlin. Explore the canals and choose a major museum. |
| **June 1–2** | **Maastricht** — 1 night | Travel by train from Amsterdam. Spend the afternoon and evening around the historic centre. |
| **June 2–6** | **Paris** — 4 nights | Travel via Liège. **June 3, 4 and 5 are your three full Paris days.** |
| **June 6–8** | **Lyon** — 2 nights | Take a high-speed train from Paris. Visit Vieux Lyon, Fourvière and the riverside districts. |
| **June 8–11** | **Barcelona** — 3 nights | Take a direct train from Lyon if available on your date. Visit Sagrada Família, Park Güell and the Gothic Quarter. |
| **June 11–14** | **Madrid** — 3 nights | Take a high-speed train from Barcelona. Explore the Prado, Retiro Park and Royal Palace. |
| **June 14–16** | **Prague** — 2 nights | Fly from Madrid on June 14. Aim for an early arrival and a June 16 departure that gives you approximately two days there. |
| **June 16–17** | **Naples** — 1 night | Fly from Prague to Naples, with a connection if necessary. Staying overnight gives you time before the ferry to Capri. |
| **June 17–18** | **Capri** — 1 night | Take a morning ferry to Capri. Explore Capri town and Anacapri; stay overnight on the island. |
| **June 18–21** | **Rome** — 3 nights | Ferry back to Naples, then take a high-speed train to Rome. You’ll have two full days plus your arrival afternoon. |
| **June 21–24** | **Florence** — 3 nights | Take a high-speed train from Rome. Visit Florence on June 21 and 23, with a **Pisa day trip on June 22**. |
| **June 24–27** | **Milan** — 3 nights | Take a high-speed train from Florence. Explore Milan June 24–25. On **June 26, take a direct train to Lugano and return directly to Milan** that evening. |
| **June 27–29** | **Halle (Saale)** — 2 nights | Return to Halle on June 27. Keep June 28 free before your trip ends June 29. |

A few transport choices make this work:

- **Berlin → Amsterdam:** a direct train takes roughly six hours. This satisfies your preference to enter the Netherlands from Berlin or Paris.
- **Maastricht → Paris:** travel by train via Liège; allow approximately three to four hours, depending on connections.
- **Lyon → Barcelona:** a direct train takes around five hours, but check whether it operates on your travel date.
- **Madrid → Prague and Prague → Naples:** plan these as flight days. Confirm flights before booking the surrounding hotels.
- **Milan → Lugano → Milan:** direct trains take approximately 1 hour 15 minutes each way. Keep your luggage at your Milan hotel.
- **Milan → Halle on June 27:** reserve this whole day for travel. Compare flights to Leipzig/Halle or Berlin followed by a train, against an all-day rail journey.

For Paris, you could use **June 3 for the Eiffel Tower and Seine**, **June 4 for the Louvre and central Paris**, and **June 5 for Montmartre and another neighbourhood of your choice**.

Book the fixed **Prague dates and connecting flights first**, followed by the June 27 return to Halle. Then book the main train journeys, Capri accommodation and timed-entry attractions. Ferry conditions can affect Capri travel, so leave generous time between the ferry back to Naples and your train to Rome.
